$comment: CANONICAL current-state design truth for MAANTA. Diffable, machine-checked. See README.md for provenance and docs/design-truth-protocol.md for the rules. Every `route` on a `current` frame is validated against src/app by src/lib/__tests__/design-truth.test.ts — a renamed or deleted route fails CI.

reconstructedFrom: repo routes, guards and migrations verified directly
provenance.sourceNote: The named .dc.html is a Claude Design canvas (same family as design/claim-and-till). It was NOT reachable from the session that built this file — not in the repo, Notion, Google Drive or Canva. Nothing here is copied from it; every row was re-derived from the sources listed above. Replace this file when the canvas is exported, and keep the schema.

statusLabels.current: Shipped and current-state. Code must match this row; a mismatch is drift to fix.
statusLabels.design-ahead: Designed but deliberately not built. Do NOT implement without a decision.
statusLabels.superseded: Replaced by a current row. Kept for provenance; never an implementation authority.
statusLabels.historical: Predates the frozen brief. Provenance only.

runtimeRules.success-fee: KES 30 per verified redemption, debited at merchant verification, or recorded as arrears.
runtimeRules.verify-anyway: Wallet state never blocks verification; disputes route to admin after the fact.
runtimeRules.zero-balance-gate: A merchant with no balance cannot create new deals (redemptions still work).
runtimeRules.deal-limit: Standard 1 / Elite 2 active deals; flash is Elite-only. Trigger: enforce_deal_limit.
runtimeRules.claim-phone-gate: Under the Clerk strategy, claiming requires a verified phone (/verify-phone).
runtimeRules.otp-expiry: Ticket code is valid until deal expiry + 15 minutes.
runtimeRules.staff-permissions: merchant_staff booleans can_verify/can_deals/can_topup/can_purchase; owners hold all four.
runtimeRules.stripe-phase-1: Card (Stripe Checkout) is the shipped top-up rail. M-Pesa STK is planned, blocked on IntaSend credentials.
runtimeRules.demo-mode: Synthetic rows are excluded from public surfaces unless demo mode is explicitly on.
runtimeRules.node-scope: Node 0 = BBS Mall is the live node; other nodes are seeded rehearsal.

frames.title: Redemption detail (release, appeal, reverse fee)
frames.notes: Fee reversal requires a decision note at route, RPC and DB layers.

frames.title: Founder executive dashboard
frames.notes: Read-only KPIs + shortcuts into /admin. Gated on the admin role — there is no founder DB role. Split plan: docs/skills/founder-role-split.md.

frames.title: Agent console
frames.notes: Agent + admin only. No approvals, no fee reversal, no /admin.

frames.title: Lead capture (48h lock)
frames.notes: Page-level role gate plus the API gate.

frames.title: Merchant dashboard
frames.notes: Quick actions are filtered to what this user may do; the block hides entirely if none apply.

frames.title: Create deal wizard
frames.notes: Blocks up front on the plan limit and surfaces the zero-balance top-up CTA; cover image required; M9 charge disclosure unskippable.

frames.title: My deals (active)
frames.notes: Requires can_deals for create CTAs. Plan line shows used/limit; create CTAs hide at the limit.

frames.title: Archived deals (repost / delete)
frames.notes: Last 5 expired deals. Repost/Delete render only with can_deals.

frames.title: Merchant onboarding wizard
frames.notes: what3words gate; optional agent attribution.

frames.title: Plan & billing
frames.notes: Needs can_purchase to appear in More/Settings.

frames.title: Redemption keypad (two-step resolve then charge)
frames.notes: Requires can_verify. Fee is disclosed before the single Confirm; resolving charges nothing.

frames.title: Redemption history
frames.notes: Informational — visible to any merchant user including verify-only staff.

frames.title: Staff roster
frames.notes: Owner-only. New invites default to verify-only.

frames.title: Top up wallet
frames.notes: Card is primary wherever IntaSend credentials are absent; the M-Pesa form is not rendered there.

frames.title: Wallet ledger
frames.notes: Ledger readable by any merchant user; the Top-up CTA needs can_topup.

frames.title: Browse map + list
frames.notes: Leaflet/OSM. what3words stays server-only.

frames.title: Deal detail (YOU PAY + itemised breakdown)
frames.notes: The only surface that itemises charges; elsewhere they collapse to one line.

frames.title: Discover feed
frames.notes: Rails: Top picks near you (flash) · Neighbourhood favourites (boosted) · All active deals (standard) · Your favourites. The standard rail is NOT distance-filtered; per-card distance shows only where merchant GPS exists.

frames.title: Notifications list
frames.notes: Derived from the shopper's own activity; no notifications table exists. Preferences are a separate screen at /you/notifications.

frames.title: Search + filter sheet
frames.notes: Filter types: all | standard | flash | boosted. The feed's See-all links land here with ?type=flash and ?type=boosted, so the sheet must be able to represent both.

frames.title: Select mall / node
frames.notes: Sits outside the (shopper) shell, so it carries its own back affordance.

frames.title: Claimed code ticket (S5)
frames.notes: Card holds label + code + live countdown only; price renders outside it.

frames.title: "Deals near me" proximity rail
frames.notes: The rail is not distance-filtered and merchant GPS is optional, so the title promised a guarantee the query never made. Real proximity ranking needs a geolocation decision + a merchant GPS backfill.

frames.title: M-Pesa-primary top-up (STK push as the lead action)
frames.notes: Historic ideal. Presenting M-Pesa as primary implies a live rail MAANTA does not have. Do not restore without IntaSend credentials.

frames.title: Self-serve Elite subscription purchase
frames.notes: Elite is activated by the MAANTA team; /merchant/plan/upgrade routes to support by design. Needs a subscription payment rail.

frames.title: Mall-operator analytics dashboard
frames.notes: Frozen-UI deferred item. No route, no code. Do not build without a decision.

frames.title: Live M-Pesa STK top-up
frames.notes: Code path exists and stays dormant. Blocked on IntaSend credentials, not on engineering.

coverage: Primary screens plus every surface that carries a role gate or a runtime rule. Leaf/legacy routes are intentionally omitted: /profile -> /you, /deals -> /my-deals and /notifications/preferences -> /you/notifications are redirects, and /app-bootstrap is a role router, not a screen. Adding a new gated or rule-bearing route means adding a frame.
